topic: remove white water rings from wood furniture
core_question: How do I get rid of a white water ring/heat mark on a wood table?
answer_summary: Rub mayonnaise or a paste of baking soda and toothpaste into the ring and wipe off, or press a warm iron over a cloth laid on the mark in short passes to draw out the moisture, then buff with polish.
